caption: The drawing features a single large pitcher or teapot centered on the page, rendered in shades of gray using pencil or graphite. The vessel has a rounded body that narrows towards the top, a prominent spout on the left, and a curved handle on the right extending upward and outward from the rim. The lid is domed with a knob on top. The body of the vessel shows subtle shading to create a sense of volume and light reflection. Below and to the right of the main pitcher, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same object, accompanied by handwritten dimensions and notes. The background is plain, and the drawing is framed by a faintly outlined rectangular border, with slightly yellowed edges indicative of aged paper.
title: Pewter Covered Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
